instructions.purpose: Define the visual manifestation of an Enochian Governor based on their core attributes
considerations: Consider the governor's element, aethyr level, and role
Ensure visual aspects reflect their mystical nature and power
Create a cohesive visual identity that aids in recognition and invocation
Balance traditional Enochian symbolism with unique characteristics

form.name: GEOMETRIC
form.description: A crystalline manifestation of sacred geometry, pulsing with divine light

color.variations: Shifts between platinum and pearl depending on spiritual energy
color.symbolism: Represents divine wisdom and ethereal purity

geometry.movement: Rotates in perfect golden ratio spirals

environment.manifestations: Creates subtle reality distortions and heightened spiritual awareness

energy_signature.unique_markers: Distinct harmonic resonance with angelic frequencies

light_shadow.special_effects: Casts shadows that reveal hidden truths

validation_rules.element_alignment: Visual aspects must reflect elemental nature
validation_rules.aethyr_influence: Higher aethyrs should have more complex/abstract forms
validation_rules.role_reflection: Visual aspects should aid in role fulfillment
validation_rules.uniqueness: Must have at least 3 unique identifying features
validation_rules.consistency: All aspects should form a cohesive whole
